title: Correction
description: A reviewed hand correction of one upstream advisory for one product: corrections/<product>/<advisory-id>.yml. Ingest replaces the ranges it read from upstream with these ranges and says so on the advisory.

advisory.description: Any id of the advisory cluster (the CVE id or the GHSA id). Must equal the file name without .yml.

product.description: The catalog product whose ranges are corrected. Must equal the folder name.

reason.description: Why the upstream ranges are wrong, in one or two plain sentences written by a person. Shown on the site next to the advisory.

evidence.description: Where the corrected ranges come from: the vendor's release notes, the fix commit or the upstream issue reporting the typo.

upstream_ranges.description: The ranges ingest read from upstream when the correction was written. When the upstream reading changes, ingest still applies the correction but warns that it needs a recheck.

ranges.description: The corrected affected ranges, in the product's version scheme, in the order they are published.

appliedCorrection.title: AppliedCorrection
appliedCorrection.description: A hand correction as it appears inside a published advisory: the ranges of product were corrected by Advisorydeck because the upstream record is wrong.

advisory.description: The id the correction is filed under: corrections/<product>/<advisory>.yml in the repository.

upstream_ranges.description: What the upstream record said, as ingest read it, for comparison. An empty list means upstream gave no readable range.
